title: tc-integration-flow
description: Integrations rotating past a data hub, each sending a beam into it.

label.description: The scene's accessible name (it is an image) – defaults to one naming the first integrations

items.description: Integrations that rotate through the pills (5 or more look best); unset or empty shows a default set

name.description: Shown as the second line of the pill, e.g. "Slack"

icon.description: Logo element (cloned), drawn into a 64 × 64 box inside the round badge (an <svg> fills the box)

mono.description: Single-color logo: white on the passing pills, black (white in dark mode) in the centre
